causality.actual_receipt: present-day retrieval UTC recorded separately, never backdated; proxy available_at=end+lag
causality.availability_grade: ARCHIVAL_EVENT_TIME_RECONSTRUCTED; original live receipts not claimed
causality.funding_features: NONE; realized ex-post settlement records only, never future funding as a signal

controls.Tactical: known RC1 Controller hard-FAIL reference only; NOT_COMPUTABLE without matching derivative/reference-universe inputs; no old outcomes re-execution or policy resurrection
controls.WAIT_NO_TRADE: zero capital exposure and PnL, undefined risk-normalized return; counts every fixed slot
controls.matched: for each candidate filled entry, naive LONG and SHORT at identical entry time, risk, maxhold; independent diagnostic controls cannot affect candidate trades; compare to balanced 50/50 mean of matched directions
controls.unconditional_signal: every eligible hourly decision slot, same ATR stop, exits/costs/liquidity/purge/no-overlap

costs.fee_semantics: fee applied to modeled adverse entry/exit prices; spread and slippage separately charged; no discounts or fee rebates
costs.funding_actual: public recorded event rates and intervals, charges where entry_ms<settlement_ms<=exit_ms; direction*rate positive charges, negative benefits conservatively discarded
costs.funding_missing: uniform whole-campaign PROXY_STRESS_ONLY if any symbol-month absent, checksum invalid or schedule gap >8h; base adverse 0.0004 and stress 0.0008 at every UTC 00/08/16h settlement
costs.funding_missing_verdict: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; do not treat proxy-only historical funding as measured cost
costs.funding_price_proxy: quantity*max(raw entry,settlement minute high) as funding notional; actual mark price not available, explicitly proxy not measured payment
costs.funding_stress: 2*max(adverse recorded rate,0.0004) per verified settlement; no favorable funding assumed
costs.latency_stress: entry delayed one extra minute, same decisions/maxhold/partition rules; no new signals
costs.liquidity_stress: same decisions/trades, participation <=0.0001; otherwise unfilled, no reoptimization
costs.neighborhood: NOT_RUN; no candidate tuning or extra strategies

diagnostics: gross/net R and PnL_USDT, return on allocated unleveraged capital
realized portfolio drawdown and tail net_R; not full minute MTM drawdown
time blocks and joint block bootstrap

eligibility.OHLC: positive finite low<=open/close<=high, nonnegative volumes, timestamp order; discontinuous price open vs prior close is valid market gap, not missing row
eligibility.funding_coverage: timestamps unique in exact month; interval >0 <=8h; complete start/end/cadence across whole May-July for every asset or uniform adverse proxy fallback
eligibility.minute_coverage: 100% each selected price symbol-month; any gap/duplicate/corrupt clock/source =>SOURCE_OR_METHOD_BLOCKED, no outcome filler
eligibility.signal_wait: missing/flat or risk outside bounds ->WAIT; never forward fill derivative or price data

execution.MFE_MAE: full extrema on completed pre-exit minutes; stop minute MFE excludes unknown pre-stop extremes; TP minute MAE uses conservative full-minute adverse excursion
execution.collision: SL-first in same minute; gaps worse stop min(stop,open) LONG / max(stop,open) SHORT; favorable target gaps receive target only
execution.leverage: <=1x entry notional accounting; no margin-return amplification, compounding, borrowing, liquidation profit or martingale
execution.liquidity: entry notional <=0.001*preceding completed minute quote volume; zero volume/stale/missing bars deny fill
execution.maker: no maker orders, no guaranteed limit fills; target executions also taker
execution.positions: one open trade per symbol per strategy; no new signal until preceding exit end; at most three asset positions
execution.precision: fresh Decimal Context(prec=28,ROUND_HALF_EVEN), derived strings quantized 12 decimals; no ambient precision dependency
execution.stop: fixed raw entry +/-1.5 ATR; entry fee/spread/slippage charged separately
execution.timeout: last minute close after exact 4h/12h max hold

features.ATR24: arithmetic mean last 24 true ranges against preceding closes
features.BREAKOUT_LONG: last close > max highs preceding 24 hours
features.BREAKOUT_SHORT: last close < min lows preceding 24 hours
features.TREND_PULLBACK_LONG: 24h return >0.01; last low <= SMA24 < last close; close > open
features.TREND_PULLBACK_SHORT: 24h return <-0.01; last high >= SMA24 > last close; close < open
features.clock: UTC epoch-aligned completed 1m -> 15m/1h/4h, no interpolation; primary signals 1h only
features.regime: 24h return >1% UP, <-1% DOWN, otherwise RANGE; diagnostic only

grid.reason: OHLCV does not prove queue priority or intraminute limit-fill order; credible empirical maker grid not implemented; relinquish four candidate slots

hard_stops: future bar signal or same-bar execution

ranking.NO_GO: complete data/actual rate schedules, all eight support gates met, and every candidate stress mean<=0; otherwise unsupported/uncertain =>DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY
ranking.positive_interpretation: exploratory developmental candidates only; no independently validated alpha
ranking.score: pooled higher-cost mean net_R descending, candidate_id lexical tie break; full table precedes ranking
shortlist_requirements: at least2 of3 partition stress means>=0

sources.checksum: each official .CHECKSUM required, SHA256 archive and uncompressed CSV; unique fresh /tmp cache only
sources.local_sources: NONE_AUTHORIZED; no existing market cache reads
sources.product_identity: official futures/um publisher namespace plus exact unsuffixed BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT perpetual contracts; quarterly/spot/COIN-M rejected

support.bootstrap_rng: SHA256 ASCII G2R2:{seed}:{replicate}:{draw}, first8 bytes big-endian modulo number of blocks; exact draws stable across Python versions
support.cluster: UTC seven-day blocks anchored 2026-05-01 jointly across symbols; preserve common shocks; trades cluster by entry; partial final block retained/disclosed
support.interval: 95% descriptive two-sided plus one-sided Bonferroni lower 0.05/(8*2)=0.003125 quantile for stress net and incremental matched balanced control, no confirmatory p-value
